authorization.role: owner of the hardware, the network and the lab.example domain
authorization.reference: docs/authorization.md — signed note recording ownership and the agreed window

findings.title: NAS admin interface reachable on the LAN without authentication
findings.evidence: curl -s http://10.0.5.10:5000/admin | head returns the dashboard HTML with HTTP 200, no session cookie required
findings.remediation: Bound the interface to localhost, moved access behind the reverse proxy with SSO and mTLS for the management VLAN
findings.verifiedAt: 2026-07-08 — the same curl now returns connection refused from the LAN and 401 through the proxy

findings.title: Media server served over plain HTTP with a session cookie missing Secure and HttpOnly
findings.evidence: ZAP baseline report docs/scans/zap-2026-07-02.html, alerts 10011 and 10010
findings.remediation: Terminated TLS at the reverse proxy, redirected HTTP, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax on the session cookie

findings.title: Printer exposes SNMP v1 with the public community string
findings.remediation: SNMP disabled on the device; the printer moved to the IoT VLAN with no route to trusted hosts
findings.verifiedAt: 2026-07-08 — snmpwalk times out and the IoT rule denies the path

findings.title: TLS certificate is self-signed, so clients are trained to click through warnings
findings.evidence: testssl.sh output docs/scans/testssl-2026-07-03.txt, chain of trust section
findings.remediation: Issue certificates from an internal CA distributed to lab devices; documented in the runbook
